payload.reason: The evidence provides sufficient information about the binary classifier used in the study, including its training methodology and performance.

claims.text: The binary classifier is trained to identify publications that meet specific criteria based on relevant sentences extracted from the text.
The classifier utilizes a Bernoulli Naïve Bayes model trained on binary occurrence matrices created from n-grams extracted from the publications.
The classifier performs better when trained on relevant sentences identified by the method than on randomly selected sentences from the text.
